title: Cable Management
description: Manage cable connections in the data center, support topology visualization and batch inventory

topology.title: Cable Topology
topology.scanPlaceholder: Scan a panel or plug label to jump there
topology.choosePanel: Pick a device and a panel to see its connections
topology.hint: Click a panel to see its ports; double-click to centre on it
topology.notLocated: This label is not a panel or a cable end
topology.endLoose: This plug is not in a port; the cable details are open

manualInventory.title: Cable Batch Inventory
manualInventory.description: Register cables of the same spec in bulk: scan the plug labels on both ends of each cable (A, B, A, B...); each pair is stored as soon as it is complete.
manualInventory.step1Desc: Basic information (type, color, etc.) of this batch of cables will be applied to all recorded cables
manualInventory.step2Desc: Scan the labels on both plugs of a cable; scanning end B submits it

placeholders.portId: Scan or type a plug label

messages.deleteConfirm: Are you sure to delete this cable?
messages.duplicatePort: End B cannot use the same label as end A
messages.baseInfoConfirmed: Cable basic information is set, start scanning
messages.baseInfoNotSet: Cable basic information is not set

labels.selectPanel: Select a panel under this device

detail.disconnectConfirm: Unplug this end? The plug stays loose on the same panel.

scrap.title: Scrap cable
scrap.description: Scan a label on either end, confirm, and the whole cable is scrapped: both labels become void and the cable leaves its ports.
scrap.scanLabel: Scan or type a cable end label
scrap.notEndpoint: This label is not on a cable end
scrap.confirmContent: Both labels become void and the cable record is deleted. This cannot be undone.
scrap.success: Cable scrapped; both labels are void
scrap.help: Scrapping voids both labels (they are never handed out again) and deletes the cable and its ends; the ports become free.

create.title: New cable connection
create.singleDesc: Scan a panel label (or pick one); you may only park on the panel or click a port. Then scan the plug label: an existing plug is plugged into the port, a new plug creates a new cable (the other end gets a label and stays loose).
create.dualDesc: Pick two free ports; plug labels are optional and allocated when empty.
create.portHint: Without a port the plug stays parked on the panel; click a free port to select it
create.plugExisting: This plug belongs to an existing cable; it will be plugged into the port
create.plugNew: New plug; a new cable will be created
create.notPanel: This label is not a panel
